subject.title: feat(agents): return sessionId from sessions_spawn accept payload

question: Should accepted native `sessions_spawn` results permanently guarantee the durable child-session UUID for ordinary, forked, and collector spawn modes, with `sessionKey` retained as the documented alias of `childSessionKey`?
rationale: The code exposes a new agent-facing session-state contract rather than only repairing an internal implementation detail; the durable-ID guarantee and alias should be an intentional maintained API surface across modes.

options.title: Confirm the durable-ID contract
options.body: Confirm the cross-mode contract, then refresh the branch and validate fork and collector persisted-ID behavior before merge.

options.title: Narrow the returned contract
options.body: If only ordinary spawns should expose this identity, revise the result shape and documentation so unsupported modes do not imply the same guarantee.

options.title: Pause the API addition
options.body: Keep the PR open until an agents-session owner decides whether this agent-facing result contract belongs in the supported surface.

recommendation.title: Confirm the durable-ID contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the cross-mode contract, then refresh the branch and validate fork and collector persisted-ID behavior before merge.
